interpretation.finding: The non-monotone Lebedev behavior was an endpoint-resolution problem. Continuous-mu harmonic kernels converge to about 1e-12 for ell<=6, while the 302-point collocation retains 7e-4 spectral-action errors but already resolves P1/P2 much better.

limitations: The incoming frequency remains centre sampled to match v0.30; two-sided finite-volume frequency integration is the next step.
This is the no-recoil two-level Hummer-II reference, not the full COM-resolved Kramers-Heisenberg kernel.
Stimulated scattering and the Rybicki detailed-balance completion are not yet included.
The harmonic kernel is stored only through ell=6; nonlinear large-shear release requires an ell_max convergence audit.

next_stage.name: C3B2B1C_finite_volume_and_ellmax_convergence
